notes: Reimagined FPS Boost updated to 1.0.39 — the 'Lock Entity Distance' option now actually works. Previous builds (1.0.38) enforced the vanilla entityDistanceScaling option, but a third-party mod (BetterFPSDist) could override it via a render mixin, making the lock appear to do nothing. 1.0.39 fixes the enforcement, and any conflicting BetterFPSDist-like mod must NOT be installed alongside FPS Boost when using the lock.
